'''Shu Yen's lightsaber''' was the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] owned by [[Shu Yen]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Diala Passil/Legends|Diala Passil]]'s mentor.<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set" />

==Behind the scenes==
'''Shu Yen's lightsaber''' was introduced in the starter set of the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] tactical miniatures [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]''.
